# M9OMS VLDO V2

> A discrete very low dropout linear voltage regulator for QRP amateur radio.
> 8-18 VDC in, selectable 9.0 / 12.0 / 13.8 V out at up to 2 A, with dropout
> below 100 mV at 1 A. Current shipping revision is V2.1. Sold as a
> self-assembly kit at https://m9oms.com

Static and dynamic performance are measured on production hardware by
independent parties (KC7XE, June 2026; CR7BTQ, August 2026). Loop
characterisation, PSRR and broadband noise remain outstanding.

## Documentation

- [Design rationale and specification](https://radio-uncensored.github.io/qrp-vldo-regulator/design.html): topology, design background, full specification table, validation status
- [DC and thermal measurements](https://radio-uncensored.github.io/qrp-vldo-regulator/measurements.html): dropout, line and load regulation, thermal data, measured by KC7XE
- [Oscilloscope measurements](https://radio-uncensored.github.io/qrp-vldo-regulator/transient.html): noise floor, load steps, power-on and power-off, measured by CR7BTQ on V2.1
- [V1.1 vs V2 comparison](https://radio-uncensored.github.io/qrp-vldo-regulator/improvements.html): what changed and why
